blind_title: What satellites and our robot cannot see

ahead_irrigate: Irrigate around {day}: about {m3} m³ per feddan.
ahead_noirr: No irrigation needed in the next 16 days.
ahead_rainfed: Rain-fed field: {rain} mm of rain forecast in the next 16 days.
ahead_totals: Forecast: {rain} mm rain, {et0} mm crop-water demand (ET0)
out_caveat: not bias-corrected; not used in scores
climate_note: Past years are adjusted to today's climate ({tr} °C per decade measured at this field).
tm_sub: MODIS shows which seasons this field was green. Each one is replayed on that year's real weather: what you spent and earned, and what the suggested rotation would have.
tm_line: Since {first}, the suggested rotation would have saved {water} m³ of water and earned {profit} EGP more per feddan.
tm_line_field: On your {fed} feddans: {water} m³ of water and {profit} EGP.
tm_none: No satellite history for this point yet.
canal_sub: Farms on a Delta canal share its water. This plans them together: each farm stays within 10 points of its own best plan, and the summer sowing dates are spread so the canal's worst week is as light as possible.
canal_demo: Demo canal: five farms near Kafr El-Sheikh
canal_line: The canal's worst week falls from {now} to {coord} m³ ({pct}% lower), {extra}% beyond what each farm reaches alone, and no one gives up more than {gu} points.
inv_sub2: Profit per feddan per year for the same three rotations when prices or weather move. Median, and in brackets the worst one-in-ten year.
bt_sub: Forecast made from earlier years only, scored against what each season's real NASA weather produced.
canal_nogu: and no farmer gives anything up.
pl_sub: Recent satellite images show how the field is growing. Field Pulse compares them with the weather and season, and estimates greenness over the coming weeks.
pl_st_expected: about what the weather and the season explain
pl_st_below: below what the weather and the season explain
pl_next: Next 16 days: {trend}, likely NDVI {lo}–{hi} (normal for the date: {normal}).
pl_scout: The weather does not explain this drop. Something on the field might: walk it or send the Scout to check leaves and soil salinity.
pl_skill: Tested on the last three seasons it never saw: {pct}% more accurate than 'no change', {cov}% of outcomes inside its 80% range · {n} training samples
chat_sub: Speak or type. Answers come from the same models as this page.
chat_ph: Ask about planting, water, weather, prices…
chat_hello: What would you like to know about this field? Ask about crops, irrigation or prices, or use the microphone.
pm_sub: Build a crop plan from your field’s weather history, soil and water supply.
pm_ph: Answer, or ask for a change…
pm_hello: Welcome. Where is your field? Tap “Use my location” if you are standing in it, type your governorate, or pick it on the map.
pm_empty:
Let’s plan the next three years

Tell us what you grow, your field area and how reliable your water supply is. We’ll compare crop rotations and planting dates using the weather recorded for this field.

You can change the plan as you go: “keep rice”, “use less water”, or “my field is 3 feddans”.

pm_tradeoff: Every option we tested: water against profit
pm_fi: Your field's greenness from MODIS is {f}% of the Delta median; yields are scaled to it.
pm_pulse_ok: Field Pulse (latest image {d}): about what the weather explains.
pm_pulse_bad: Field Pulse (latest image {d}): below what the weather explains — check the field.
pm_pulse_na: Field Pulse: no satellite history yet.
pm_source: Computed from NASA POWER, MODIS (GIBS), FAO-56, FAO-29 and quoted prices
